text: When checked, HQueue combines the job command’s standard output and error streams into one output log on the HQueue web interface. Otherwise, the output streams are separated, and the standard output and error streams can be viewed and downloaded separately from the job view page on the HQueue web interface.
A list of custom resources and respective counts that should be defined on the client machine when running the job.
A list of variable names and values that should be defined on the client machine when running the job.  The variables appear as shell environment variables.
